suspension_appeal_resolution_valid.name: suspension_appeal_resolution_valid
suspension_appeal_resolution_valid.value: ("suspension_appeal"."status" = 'open' AND "suspension_appeal"."resolution" IS NULL AND "suspension_appeal"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("suspension_appeal"."status" = 'resolved' AND "suspension_appeal"."resolution" IN ('lifted', 'banned', 'rejected') AND "suspension_appeal"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

recipe_ingredient_shape_valid.name: recipe_ingredient_shape_valid
recipe_ingredient_shape_valid.value:
((
				"recipe_ingredient_node"."type" = 'group'
				AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."inferred" IS NOT NULL
				AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."status" IS NULL
				AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."amount_text" IS NULL
				AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."quantity" IS NULL
				AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."unit_label" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"recipe_ingredient_node"."type" = 'ingredient'
				AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."inferred" IS NULL
				AND (
					"recipe_ingredient_node"."status" = 'parsed'
					AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."amount_text" IS NOT NULL
					AND ("recipe_ingredient_node"."quantity" IS NULL OR "recipe_ingredient_node"."quantity" > 0)
					OR
					"recipe_ingredient_node"."status" = 'missing-amount'
					AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."amount_text" IS NULL
					AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."quantity" IS NULL
					AND "recipe_ingredient_node"."unit_label" IS NULL
				))
		) IS TRUE

recipe_link_label_valid.name: recipe_link_label_valid
recipe_link_label_valid.value: char_length("recipe_link"."label") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "recipe_link"."label" = btrim("recipe_link"."label") AND "recipe_link"."label" !~ '[\[\]\n\r]'

recipe_report_resolution_valid.name: recipe_report_resolution_valid
recipe_report_resolution_valid.value: ("recipe_report"."status" = 'open' AND "recipe_report"."resolution" IS NULL AND "recipe_report"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("recipe_report"."status" = 'resolved' AND "recipe_report"."resolution" IN ('made-private', 'deleted', 'dismissed') AND "recipe_report"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
